settings.title: Adapter settings
settings.summary: Settings summary: the language is read-only; Save submits only valid effective changes from this drawer.
settings.accessSummary: Current access: {{level}}. Sharing permissions can be viewed and managed here.
settings.name: Name
settings.unsavedClose: Settings have unsaved changes. Close and discard them?
settings.readOnlyAccess: This is a read-only share: code, dependencies, configuration, logs and history can be viewed, but writes, runs, AI and lifecycle actions are unavailable.
settings.editAccess: This is an editable share: editing, saving, running and trigger configuration are allowed, but deleting the Adapter and managing sharing permissions are unavailable.
settings.archivedDescription: This Adapter has been removed from the active list.
settings.deleteDescription: Permanent deletion cannot be undone. It removes Executions and logs, input/output/error data, Schedule/Webhook configuration, Revisions, sharing permissions and code Credential bindings.
settings.deleteWarningActive: Receiving or execution is still active: the entry will be stopped and the Worker asked to cancel first. Deletion waits for cancelled and no active Execution; an offline or timed-out Worker safely blocks it.
settings.deleteWarningIdle: This cannot be undone. The dedicated Worker environment is cleaned by an online Worker; the global Credential object is not deleted.
settings.deleteReasonLocked: Stop the Adapter before deleting it
settings.deleteWarningWebhook: An Adapter cannot be deleted while it is receiving or has active calls.
settings.deleteWarningTask: An Adapter cannot be deleted while its schedule or execution is active.
settings.dangerHint: Deletion removes the Adapter, its history and sharing relationships, but never the global Credential object.
